title: PROOF line carrying a signature
notes: One WebSocket TEXT message, no terminator (SCHEMA.md §Kinds handshake-text). Pins only the PROOF TEXT GRAMMAR ([DSC1-HELLO-*], decision ncz.5-D1: cryptographic binding is out of scope here) — that encodeProof renders one base64url token after the PROOF prefix and that parseProof of the line round-trips to the same Proof signature. Signature validity is DSC1's own concern (HelloProtocolTest, WsAuthenticatedHelloTest), not this vector's. The signature is a synthetic constant, not a real signature's (decision ncz.5-D6): bytes 0xA0..0xDF (64 bytes, an Ed25519 signature's length). The base64url token is unpadded per RFC 4648 §5, matching what encodeProof emits.
